title: Eurex Plans Hybrid Clearing for Digital Securities and Margin Collateral
why_it_matters: The plan would let institutions finance and post qualifying digital securities through existing clearing relationships, reducing the operational split between tokenized issuance and established collateral markets.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INFRASTRUCTURE

Eurex Plans Hybrid Clearing for Digital Securities and Margin Collateral

Eurex Clearing plans to bring native digital securities into its existing repo, clearing and margin framework, including ESM issuances and the ECB GC Pooling basket.

Full analysis →
